question: The rate of growth of a population $P$ of a city is proportional to the population at any time $t$. (i) Form the differential equation. (ii) If the population doubles in 50 years, find the time in which it will triple. [4 marks]
solutionSteps: $\frac{dP}{P} = k \, dt \Rightarrow \log P = kt + C \Rightarrow P(t) = P_0 e^{kt}$.
At $t=50, P = 2P_0 \Rightarrow 2P_0 = P_0 e^{50k} \Rightarrow e^{50k} = 2 \Rightarrow k = \frac{\log 2}{50}$.
